items.rationale: Sections 7.1.10 and 5.2.6(b) preserve cover for necessary assessment of the cause and extent of the loss despite the gradual-leakage exclusion. A routine site inspection is estimated at €300 gross, below the €3,000 event cap.

items.description: Indoor leak detection, technician and vehicle
items.rationale: Sections 2.4.3, 7.1.10 and 5.2.6(a) cover locating the porous pipe sections that were leaking, including technician time. The €460 gross estimate includes about €70 for one vehicle charge under 5.2.6(c), within the €83.30 gross travel cap and the separate €1,000 leak-location cap.

items.description: Floor removal, screed preparation and disposal
items.rationale: Section 7.1.10 excludes dismantling, preparation and debris removal for building moisture damage caused by gradual pipe porosity. This whole-floor line identifies no separable work needed to access or repair the leaking pipe sections.
Section 7.1.8(b) expressly excludes provisioning for contractor personnel. The conditional estimate is €15 gross per unit for three units.
Section 7.1.10 excludes the drying and disinfection measures under 7.1.7 for moisture damage caused by gradual leakage. The bundled labour and dust protection serve the same excluded work.

Section 7.1.10 excludes the underlying drying, and 7.1.7(b) independently bars separate electricity charges when drying is billed as a lump sum. At €0.32 gross per kWh, 2,412.1 kWh would cost about €772.
